title: Card-Funded Reservation Deposits at Reinstatement — Homesite Reservation
content:
On the reinstatement of an expired Homesite Reservation hold, the reinstatement card shortening is read from the payments received on the reservation ledger with the component reservation deposit.

| Card share of the reservation deposit received | Reinstatement card shortening |
|---|---|
| card payments make up the whole of it | 2 days |
| card payments make up part but not all of it | 1 day |
| no part of it was paid by card | zero |

## Ledger examples (hypothetical)

- Reservation deposit 1000.00 paid by card: 2 days.
- Reservation deposit 1500.00 paid 1000.00 by card and 500.00 by check: 1 day.
- Reservation deposit paid by ACH, reinstatement fee paid by card: zero; only reservation deposit payments are counted.
- Card convenience fee entries are their own component and do not count as reservation deposit paid by card.
